subject: Re: Rebooking after the delay
text: Further to our earlier exchange, I have checked the rebooking options for your train connection. The disruption looks severe, and the evening departures are likely to remain unreliable. I mention this because I would still like to invite you to join me for a simple dinner if you are able to arrive safely. I know your project deadlines are demanding, so please consider it only as an optional pause rather than another obligation. It would be a pleasure to continue our conversation away from the usual work rhythm. If timing is difficult, I am content to postpone, and I will keep you informed of any useful travel updates. A quiet table can be arranged easily once your schedule settles, and I can adapt quite simply. I hope the next message from you arrives with calmer news.
